title: When to Use Passive Voice
description: Learn appropriate contexts for using passive voice

explain.ta: Passive voice-ஐ குறிப்பிட்ட சூழ்நிலைகளில் பயன்படுத்துவது சரியானது: 1) செயலை செய்பவர் தெரியாதபோது ('My bike was stolen'), 2) செயலை செய்பவர் முக்கியமில்லாதபோது ('English is spoken here'), 3) செயலை செய்பவர் தெளிவாக இருக்கும்போது ('The President was elected'), 4) formal writing-ல் (news, reports, science), 5) process descriptions-ல் ('The rice is washed, then it is cooked'). Active voice-ஐ casual மற்றும் direct communication-க்கு பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
explain.en: Use passive voice in specific situations: 1) When the doer is unknown ('My bike was stolen'), 2) When the doer is unimportant ('English is spoken here'), 3) When the doer is obvious ('The President was elected'), 4) In formal writing (news reports, scientific papers, business documents), 5) In process descriptions ('The ingredients are mixed, then the mixture is baked'). Use active voice for casual, direct communication and when emphasizing who does the action.

examples: A new law was passed yesterday.
Three people were injured in the accident.
The product is packaged and shipped.

examples.en: My wallet was stolen. (We don't know who did it)
examples.ta: என் பணப்பை திருடப்பட்டது. (யார் செய்தார்கள் என்று தெரியாது)

examples.en: Spanish is spoken in 20 countries. (The speakers are not important)
The Prime Minister was welcomed at the airport. (Obviously by officials)
examples.ta: பிரதமர் விமான நிலையத்தில் வரவேற்கப்பட்டார். (அதிகாரிகளால் என்பது தெளிவு)

examples.en: The samples were tested in the laboratory. (Scientific report)
The rice is washed and then cooked. (Process description)
Two people were killed in the storm. (News report)
The building was designed by a famous architect. (Focus on building)
examples.ta: கட்டிடம் ஒரு பிரபல கட்டிடக் கலைஞரால் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டது. (கட்டிடத்தில் கவனம்)

examples.en: Mistakes were made during the project. (Avoiding blame)
The data is collected and analyzed monthly. (Business process)
examples.ta: தரவு மாதந்தோறும் சேகரிக்கப்பட்டு பகுப்பாய்வு செய்யப்படுகிறது. (வணிக செயல்முறை)

listeningQuestions.audioText: The window was broken last night.
options: Someone broke the window last night. (Active - we know who)
The window was broken last night. (Passive - we don't know who)
They broke the window last night. (Active - specific person)

listeningQuestions.audioText: The medicine should be taken after meals.
options: You should take the medicine after meals. (Active - direct instruction)
The medicine should be taken after meals. (Passive - formal instruction)
People take the medicine after meals. (Active - general)
Someone founded the company in 1995. (Active - unknown founder)
They founded the company in 1995. (Active - vague)
The company was founded in 1995. (Passive - focus on company)

speakSentences.en: The decision was made by the board of directors.
The vegetables are washed, cut, and cooked.
Several houses were damaged in the earthquake.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Which is better for a news report? 'A bank ___'
Which is better for a recipe? 'The onions ___'
Which is better when you don't know who did it? 'My car ___'
practiceQuestions.promptTa: யார் செய்தார்கள் என்று தெரியாதபோது எது சிறந்தது? 'என் கார் ___'

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Which is better for scientific writing? 'The experiment ___'
Which is better for casual conversation? 'I ___ the book'
options: The book was read by me

masteryQuestions.promptEn: Best for a formal announcement: 'The new policy ___'
options: We will implement the new policy

masteryQuestions.promptEn: Best when the doer is obvious: 'The President ___'
Best for emphasizing the doer: 'The song ___'
Best for direct communication: 'I ___ the email'
options: The email was sent by me

masteryQuestions.promptEn: Best for telling a personal story: 'I ___ my friend'
masteryQuestions.promptTa: தனிப்பட்ட கதை சொல்ல சிறந்தது: 'நான் என் நண்பரை ___'
options: met my friend at the park
My friend was met by me
